A New Year countdown on your iPhone Home Screen

How many days until New Year? Keep the answer on your Home Screen, then watch the last eight hours tick down to midnight on your Lock Screen. Simple Count's widgets are free, and the countdown starts again by itself for the next year.

How many days until New Year?

New Year's Day 2027 is on Friday, January 1, 2027.

Set it up in a minute

  1. Ask Siri: "Add a countdown in Simple Count", then say "New Year on January 1". Simple Count picks 🎆 and makes it repeat every year by itself. Or tap + in the app, set 1 January and set Repeat to yearly.
  2. Count to midnight: edit the countdown, turn on Show countdown and set the time to 00:00. You see days, hours, minutes and seconds.
  3. Add the widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen. Step-by-step guide.

The last hours of the year

With the time set to 00:00, a Live Activity counts down to midnight from 4 pm on New Year's Eve, second by second, on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. It starts by itself; you can turn that off in Settings. With Apple Watch, the countdown is on your wrist too.

Make it more than a number

  • Count down together: share the countdown with the people you'll be with. Everyone sees the same countdown and notes on their own phone, widgets included. Sharing one countdown is free.
  • The party in the notes: sections and checklists for the menu, the drinks and who brings what.
  • Resolutions: write them in the notes and tick them off through the year. Or make a countdown for the goal itself, like a race or an exam.
  • The whole season: add Christmas and New Year's Eve too. The Next Event widget always shows the closest one. Christmas countdown widget.

Questions

Is the New Year countdown widget free?

Yes. Every widget in Simple Count is free, with no ads and no subscription. Pro is an optional one-time purchase for photo backgrounds and extras.

Can it count down to midnight with hours, minutes and seconds?

Yes. Turn on Show countdown and set the time to 00:00 on January 1. In the last eight hours a Live Activity counts down on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

Does the countdown reset after New Year?

Yes, if it repeats yearly (Siri sets that for New Year automatically). Afterwards it counts to the next New Year.

Can I share a New Year countdown with friends?

Yes. With Count Down Together everyone sees the same countdown on their own phone and widgets. Sharing one countdown is free, and joining is always free.
